title: Traefik Access Log Weekly Request Duration Trend
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=traefik:access duration_ms=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_duration, max(duration_ms) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst request duration for Traefik access log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture duration_ms on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average request duration with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It automatically whether Traefik access log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
